children: On September 27, TradingBeats monitoring showed that the address linked to Machi Big Brother, Huang Licheng, was continuing to take profits on an ETH long position. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, he still holds a 25x leveraged long position of 32,525 ETH, with an average entry price of $2,668.35 and an unrealized profit of $1.32 million.

He also holds a 40x leveraged long position of 392 BTC, with an average entry price of $84,080.1 and an unrealized profit of $170,000. In addition, he has a 10x leveraged long position of 213,500 HYPE, with an average entry price of $93.11 and an unrealized loss of $40,000.

title: Machi Big Brother Huang Licheng Continues Taking Profits on ETH Long Position
